correctness.rationale: An at-most-one 2-substring edit is exactly replacement of a contiguous removed block of size 0..2 by inserted binary block of size 0..2, including unchanged output. Reconstructed finite output balls independently and took compatibility edges iff balls are disjoint. Coloring bound produces independent classes, hence any clique extending a branch uses ≤ number of classes; all other candidates branch, establishing exhaustive upper bounds. An independent bitmask clique search over all 2^n vertices gave maxima 1,1,1,1,2,3,5,8 for n=1..8 (largest n=8 256 vertices, 24,196 visited recursion nodes), and witness size 8. The package verify.py directly enumerates two ball constructions and exhaustively uses the same valid color bound; its full source was inspected.
residual_risks: Exact only for binary n=1..8 and one 2-substring replacement/insertion/deletion; no extrapolation of Fibonacci-like tail, no asymptotic optimality claim.
Finite exhaustive correctness does not imply any values beyond the enumerated n.
